d: Director of the Regional Meteorological Centre in Bhubaneswar, Manorama Mohanty, announced that severe cyclonic storm Akwan over the Bay of Bengal is likely to cross the north Andhra Pradesh and south Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri around noon on 20 November. Speaking on the cyclone's trajectory, she stated that 'maximum sustained wind speed 90 to 100 kilometer per hour, gusting to 110 kilometer per hour' is expected during landfall. Mohanty noted that widespread rainfall will impact Odisha, prompting red alerts for heavy downpours across several districts including Kendrapara,…
